section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测设备，包括检测箱，还包括消毒组件和控温组件，所述消毒组件由固定盘、导流板、消毒槽、转轴A、履带、转轴B、电机和消毒盘组成，所述固定盘和电机安装在检测箱顶部，所述固定盘内插接有转轴A，所述转轴A顶部安装有履带，所述电机的动力输出端与转轴B的动力输入端相连，所述履带另一端安装在转轴B上，所述固定盘内安装有导流板，所述固定盘内开设有消毒槽，所述导流板位于消毒槽上方，所述固定盘底部插接有消毒盘。本实用新型通过消毒组件，对检测箱内部喷洒消毒液，进行消毒，避免对下一次检测结果产生影响，通过控温组件，控制检测箱内部的温度，使生物基因检测正常进行。

The utility model discloses a biological gene check out test set, including the detection case, still include disinfection subassembly and accuse temperature subassembly, the disinfection subassembly comprises fixed disk, guide plate, disinfection groove, pivot A, track, pivot B, motor and disinfection dish, the fixed disk and motor are installed at the detection case top, it has pivot A to peg graft in the fixed disk, the track is installed at pivot A top, the power take off end of motor links to each other with pivot B's power input end, the track other end is installed on pivot B, install the guide plate in the fixed disk, the disinfection groove has been seted up in the fixed disk, the guide plate is located disinfection groove top, it has the disinfection dish to peg graft in the fixed disk bottom. The utility model discloses a disinfection subassembly sprays the antiseptic solution to the detection case is inside, disinfects, avoids producing the influence to the testing result next time, through accuse temperature subassembly, controls the inside temperature of detection case, makes biological gene detect normally go on.

Biological gene detection equipmentTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological gene detects technical field, in particular to biological gene check out test set.

Background

The biological gene detection equipment detects DNA through blood, other body fluids and cells, detects DNA molecular information in cells of a detected person through the gene detection equipment, predicts the risk of diseases of a body, analyzes various gene conditions contained in the biological gene detection equipment, enables people to know the genetic information of the people, and avoids or delays the diseases by improving the living environment and the living habits of the people.

Patent number CN201711012815.1 discloses a biological gene check out test set, including reagent drop entry and gene detector, reagent instils into the mouth and installs the upper end at the gene detector, the bottom of gene detector is equipped with the skid resistant course, the test tube is installed to the symmetry on the gene detector, spacing is installed to the test tube upper end, spacing adopts the clearance fit mode with the test tube fixed department and is connected, the glass board is installed to spacing's upper end, the detector box is installed on the right side of gene detector. The invention is helpful to the dripping of the detection agent, the installation of the detection element and the anti-skid function of the bottom of the gene detector by arranging the reagent dripping inlet, the gene detector and the anti-skid layer, and is helpful to store the gene detection liquid at multiple positions, protect the detection liquid and install the detection element by arranging the test tube, the limiting frame, the glass plate and the detector box.

The biological gene detection device has the following disadvantages: after the gene detection work is finished, bacteria in the detection liquid can remain in the detection equipment to influence the next detection result, and the bacteria remaining in the equipment can enter the detection liquid during detection to cause the deviation of the detection result; in the gene detection process, the requirement on the survival temperature of experimental cells is high, and if the temperature environment cannot reach the standard, certain influence is brought to related experiments.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The main object of the utility model is to provide a biological gene detection equipment, can effectively solve the problem in the background art.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a biological gene check out test set, includes the detection case, still includes disinfection subassembly and accuse temperature subassembly, the disinfection subassembly comprises fixed disk, guide plate, disinfection groove, pivot A, track, pivot B, motor and disinfection dish, the fixed disk is installed at the detection case top with the motor, it has pivot A to peg graft in the fixed disk, the track is installed at pivot A top, the power take off end of motor links to each other with pivot B's power input end, the track other end is installed on pivot B, install the guide plate in the fixed disk, the disinfection groove has been seted up in the fixed disk, the guide plate is located disinfection groove top, it has the disinfection dish to peg graft in the fixed disk bottom.

Furthermore, the temperature control assembly consists of a cooling box, a heating box, a controller, a heat conducting plate, an electric heater, a semiconductor refrigeration sheet, a heat dissipation net and a temperature measuring probe, wherein the heat conducting plate and the electric heater are installed inside the heating box; the temperature inside the detection box is controlled by the temperature control assembly, so that the biological gene detection is normally carried out.

Furthermore, the power input ends of the controller, the motor, the electric heater, the semiconductor refrigeration sheet and the temperature measuring probe are connected with the power output end of an external power supply; an external power supply connected with the motor, the motor drives the track through the rotating shaft B when rotating, the track drives the rotating shaft A, the rotating shaft A drives the disinfection plate when rotating, the disinfection plate rotates in the detection box and is connected with the external power supply of the controller, the electric heater, the semiconductor refrigeration sheet and the temperature probe, the temperature probe converts the temperature in the detection box into an electric signal and transmits the electric signal to the controller, when the internal temperature of the detection box is lower than the environment required by the biogenic detection, the controller drives the electric heater, the electric heater converts the electric energy into heat energy, when the internal temperature is higher than the set value, the controller drives the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, when the current passes through the couple formed by connecting two different semiconductor materials in series, the two ends of the couple can respectively absorb heat and emit heat, the purpose of refrigeration can be achieved, and cold air is sprayed out from the radiating net to cool the interior of the detection box.

Furthermore, spraying holes are formed in the surface of the disinfection plate; when the disinfection disc rotates, the disinfectant is sprayed out of the spraying holes, and the disinfectant can disinfect the interior of the detection box in multiple directions.

Further, a protective pad is arranged at the top of the heat conducting plate; the heat is conducted to the protective pad through the heat conducting plate, and the heat is conducted to the interior of the detection box through the protective pad, so that the temperature in the detection box rises to a set value range.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses following beneficial effect has:

1. the utility model discloses after biological gene detects, pour the antiseptic solution into in the fixed disk, flow in the disinfection inslot through the guide plate, flow in the disinfection dish again, connect the external power source of motor, through pivot B drive track when the motor rotates, track drive pivot A, drive disinfection dish when pivot A rotates, the disinfection dish rotates inside the detection case, the disinfection dish is when rotating, the antiseptic solution is followed and is sprayed in the hole, the antiseptic solution is diversified disinfects to the detection case inside, through the disinfection subassembly, spray the antiseptic solution to the detection case inside, disinfect, avoid producing the influence to next testing result.

2. Before the bio-gene is detected, the external power supply of the controller, the electric heater, the semiconductor refrigeration piece and the temperature probe is connected, the temperature probe converts the temperature in the detection box into an electric signal and transmits the electric signal to the controller, when the temperature in the detection box is lower than the environment required by bio-gene detection, the controller drives the electric heater, the electric heater converts the electric energy into heat energy, then the heat energy is transmitted to the protective pad through the heat conducting plate, the heat energy is transmitted to the interior of the detection box through the protective pad, the temperature in the detection box is increased to a set value range, when the internal temperature is higher than the set value, the controller drives the semiconductor piece, when the current passes through a galvanic couple formed by connecting two different refrigeration materials in series, the heat can be absorbed and emitted at the two ends of the galvanic couple respectively, the refrigeration purpose can be realized, the cold air is sprayed out of the heat dissipation net, the temperature inside of the detection box is reduced, the temperature inside the detection box is controlled by the temperature control assembly, so that the biological gene detection is normally carried out.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical means, creation features, achievement purposes and functions of the present invention easy to understand, the present invention is further described below with reference to the following embodiments.

As shown in fig. 1-4, a biological gene detection device, including detection case 1, still include disinfection subassembly 21 and accuse temperature subassembly 22, disinfection subassembly 21 comprises fixed disk 5, guide plate 6, disinfection groove 7, pivot A8, track 9, pivot B10, motor 11 and disinfection dish 12, fixed disk 5 and motor 11 are installed at detection case 1 top, it has pivot A8 to peg graft in the fixed disk 5, track 9 is installed at pivot A8 top, the power take off of motor 11 links to each other with the power input of pivot B10, the track 9 other end is installed on pivot B10, install guide plate 6 in the fixed disk 5, disinfection groove 7 has been seted up in the fixed disk 5, guide plate 6 is located disinfection groove 7 top, disinfection dish 12 has been pegged graft to fixed disk 5 bottom.

The temperature control assembly 22 comprises a cooling box 2, a heating box 3, a controller 4, a heat conducting plate 15, an electric heater 16, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet 18, a heat dissipation net 19 and a temperature measuring probe 20, wherein the heat conducting plate 15 and the electric heater 16 are installed inside the heating box 3, the electric heater 16 is installed at the bottom of the heat conducting plate 15, the controller 4 is installed outside the cooling box 2, a containing cavity 17 is formed in the cooling box 2, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet 18 is installed inside the containing cavity 17, the heat dissipation net 19 is installed on the inner side wall of the cooling box 2, and the temperature measuring probe 20 is installed outside the cooling box 2; the temperature control component 22 controls the temperature inside the detection box 1, so that the biological gene detection can be normally carried out.

The power input ends of the controller 4, the motor 11, the electric heater 16, the semiconductor refrigeration sheet 18 and the temperature probe 20 are connected with the power output end of an external power supply; an external power supply connected with a motor 11, the motor 11 drives a crawler 9 through a rotating shaft B10 when rotating, the crawler 9 drives a rotating shaft A8, the rotating shaft A8 drives a disinfection tray 12 when rotating, the disinfection tray 12 rotates in a detection box 1, the external power supply connected with a controller 4, an electric heater 16, a semiconductor refrigeration sheet 18 and a temperature probe 20, the temperature probe 20 converts the temperature in the detection box 1 into an electric signal and transmits the electric signal to the controller 4, when the temperature in the detection box 1 is lower than the environment required by the biogene detection, the controller 4 drives the electric heater 16, the electric heater 16 converts the electric energy into heat energy, when the internal temperature is higher than a set value, the controller 4 drives the semiconductor refrigeration sheet 18, when current passes through a couple formed by connecting two different semiconductor materials in series, the two ends of the couple can respectively absorb heat and emit heat, the refrigeration purpose can be realized, and cold air is sprayed from a heat dissipation network 19, and cooling the interior of the detection box 1.

Wherein, the surface of the disinfection plate 12 is provided with a spraying hole 13; when the disinfection disc 12 rotates, the disinfectant is sprayed out of the spraying holes 13, and the disinfectant can disinfect the interior of the detection box 1 in multiple directions.

Wherein, a protective pad 14 is arranged on the top of the heat conducting plate 15; the heat is conducted to the protection pad 14 through the heat conducting plate 15, and the heat energy is conducted to the inside of the detection box 1 through the protection pad 14, so that the temperature in the detection box 1 is increased to be within a set value range.

The foregoing shows and describes the basic principles and principal features of the invention, together with the advantages thereof. It will be understood by those skilled in the art that the present invention is not limited to the above embodiments, and that the foregoing embodiments and descriptions are provided only to illustrate the principles of the present invention without departing from the spirit and scope of the present invention.
